locked_traits.description: Concrete visual facts to hold constant across panels (identity, costume, palette, proportions). Every entry must be a real visual detail, never a restatement of these instructions.

continuity.description: How this panel relates to a prior panel or an established sequence (recurring character, location, or story beat). Leave as an empty string for a standalone image with no prior panel to be continuous with -- do not invent a sequence that does not exist.

positive_prompt.description: The only field the renderer actually reads as the image description, together with camera, composition, characters, locked_traits, and lighting. Anything the panel must show, including a required medium, color count, or art style (e.g. 'strictly two-color duotone', 'black and white line art only'), must be stated here affirmatively -- not only in negative_prompt.

negative_prompt.description: Exclusions for a human reviewer's reference only. The renderer does not apply this field, so it must never be the only place a required exclusion or medium restriction is stated -- restate it affirmatively in positive_prompt instead.
